veranderings.voor: hulle xilofone wat hulle timbila noem
veranderings.na: hulle xilofone, wat hulle timbila noem
veranderings.rede: Without the comma the relative clause reads as restrictive (only those of their xylophones they call timbila); the comma makes it describe all their xylophones, as intended.

vlae.teks: Die geskraapte bottel klink grof as jy oor sy riwwe skraap.
vlae.rede: 'geskraapte' and 'skraap' repeat each other; not changed because 'geskraapte bottel' may be the instrument's established name in earlier lessons.
